def optimise(self, low):
        S, J, F, G, K = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G, self.K
        g = GL.Graph(K + 2 * S + 2, costed=True)
        cimap = [0] * self.narcs
        for s in range(S):
            blk = self.slot_blk[s]
            for k in (0, 1, 2, 3):
                a = blk[k]
                if a < 0:
                    continue
                cimap[a] = g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], self.capa[a], 0)
        self.next_free = K
        self.build_tree(g)
        for j in range(J):
            a = self.win_arc[j]
            cimap[a] = g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], 1, 0)
        P = self.big_m(low)
        urew = []
        urest = []
        for f in range(F):
            z = self.zbase + f
            h = self.fhead[f]
            urew.append(g.add(z, h, low[f], -P))
            urest.append(g.add(z, h, self.ceiling[f] - low[f], 0))
        for gidx in range(G):
            a = self.group_arc[gidx]
            cimap[a] = g.add(self.tail[a], self.head[a], self.gceil[gidx], 0)
        n = self.next_free
        order = self.topo(g, n)
        if order is None:
            order = self.dag_order()
        pot = GL.pot_from_dag(n, g.adj, g.to, g.cap, g.cost, order)
        units, total, pot = GL.mincost_negative_augment(
            n, g.adj, g.to, g.cap, g.cost, pot, self.R, self.Z, J)
        cap = g.cap
        asg = self.decompose(g)
        nsel = 0
        for j in range(J):
            if asg[j] >= 0:
                nsel += 1
        nf = []
        for f in range(F):
            a = urew[f]
            b = urest[f]
            nf.append((low[f] - cap[a]) + (self.ceiling[f] - low[f] - cap[b]))
        self.opt_g = g
        self.opt_pot = pot[:K]
        self.cimap = cimap
        self.urew = urew
        self.urest = urest
        self.assignment = asg
        self.nsel = nsel
        self.nf = nf
        flow = [0] * self.narcs
        for i in range(self.narcs):
            if self.dense_start <= i < self.dense_end:
                continue
            flow[i] = self.capa[i] - cap[cimap[i]]
        for f in range(F):
            flow[self.flow_arc[f]] = nf[f]
        for j in range(J):
            s = asg[j]
            if s >= 0:
                k = self.dense_index.get((s, j))
                if k is not None:
                    flow[self.dense_start + k] = 1
        flow[self.back_arc] = nsel
        self.arcflow = flow
        U = 0
        A = 0
        times = self.times
        ready = self.ready
        value = self.value
        for j in range(J):
            s = asg[j]
            if s >= 0:
                U += value[j]
                A += times[s] - ready[j]
        self.utility = U
        self.age = A
        return units
